                                         Affordance, defined as the potential actions that an object                                        …
                                         offers, is crucial for embodied AI agents. For example, such
                                         knowledge directs an agent to grasp a knife by the handle
                                         for cutting or by the blade for safe handover. While ex-
                                         isting approaches have made notable progress, affordance
                                         research still faces three key challenges: data scarcity, poor                                                        Cut

                                         generalization, and real-world deployment. Specifically,                                                              Grasp

Figure 2. Illustration of the data collection process from egocentric videos. First, graspable points (depicted in purple) are localized
from clips of hand-object interaction and then projected to pre-contact frame by homography. Next, functional points (depicted in green)
are identified from tool-object interactions and mapped to the pre-contact frame of hand-object interaction through point correspondence.
Lastly, these points are used as prompts for the SAM to obtain affordance masks.

                                                                  5
Figure 4. The framework of Aff-Grasp. It first employs an open-vocabulary detector [29] to locate all objects within the scene, which are
then sent to GAT to determine if they possess the corresponding affordance required for the task. Afterwards, a 6 DoF grasp generation
model, Contact-GraspNet, leverages the object’s graspable affordance and the depth map to generate dense grasp proposals. Finally, the
robot executes affordance-specific sequential motion primitives to apply the functional part to the target.

4.3. Ablation Study
                                                                           5. Conclusion
To explore the impact of each component in our model, we
perform ablation experiments on the embedder, loss func-                   In this paper, we present a streamlined affordance learning
tion, classifiers, and designed modules. The ablation re-                  system that integrates automatic data collection from ego-
sults are summarized in Tab. 4. We first set up a baseline                 centric videos, effective model learning, and deployment on
model, which employs a frozen DeiT III [51] backbone that                  a real robot. We perform extensive experiments from both
is fully supervised on ImageNet. We then add a simple                      vision and robot perspectives, demonstrating the effective-
linear layer for patch-wise classification and utilize binary              ness of the entire affordance learning system.
